chunks: And Ibn Faḍḍāl narrated from Aḥmad ibn Yazīd, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who witnesses the accounting between two men, then is called to testimony, he said: “He should testify.”

key_terms.حِسَابَ: the accounting or reckoning under discussion
key_terms.ٱلرَّجُلَيْنِ: the two men involved in the matter
key_terms.ٱلشَّهَادَةِ: formal testimony given when called upon

ai.seo_question: Can a person testify if he directly observed the accounting between two people?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about testimony based on direct knowledge of a financial reckoning between two people. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that a person who has witnessed such an account may testify when called upon.
